title: Brief traceability register
rule: A status is set only by repository evidence or an official source. 'done' means a file in this repository implements the item. 'partial' means it is implemented with a stated gap. 'missing' means a search of the repository found no implementation. 'blocked' means a source needed to build it does not exist or cannot be reached from this environment.

status_key.done: Implemented and evidenced in this repository.
status_key.partial: Implemented in part; the gap is stated.
status_key.missing: Not found in the repository by search.
status_key.blocked: Cannot be built: the source it needs is not available.

rows.requirement: Scheduled job refreshes the official schedule, standings, team stats and injury report for each rolling slate, and rebuilds only after freshness and provenance gates pass.
rows.evidence: Workflow runs 3x daily (cron 11:15, 15:15, 22:15 UTC). engine/fetch_official.py captures sources; engine/refresh_gate.py fails closed on freshness, provenance and promotion; scripts/test_refresh_gate.py tests the gate. Latest scheduled run: success.
rows.gap: Structured parsing of stats and schedule and automated consecutive-report status diffs are still open (see §38 RFG4 'needs review').

rows.requirement: Official per-game result feed kept current: one row per game with date, teams, final score, quarter scores.
rows.evidence: data/official/results_2026-11-14.json holds 5 rows with columns date, game_id, away, home, away_pts, home_pts, away_quarters, home_quarters, ot_periods, source_url. Every row links its NBA.com game page.
rows.gap: Only the 11/14 slate is in the feed. Not verified that the scheduled job appends finals automatically. 11/15 games are not yet settled.

links.label: Sample row: DEN @ NOP game page

rows.requirement: Settle only after final scores are verified.
rows.evidence: data/settlement/settlement_2026-11-14.json settles 11/14 singles, parlays and SGPs against the official finals file. ledger entry 3 records its hash. scripts/settle_2026_11_14.py performs the settlement.
rows.gap: Settlement is run by hand for each slate and is not part of the scheduled job. 11/15 is due after its game day ends.

rows.requirement: Store every injury PDF with its timestamp, and diff consecutive reports to detect status changes.
rows.evidence: Transcriptions with revision_time_et and retrieved_utc: data/official/injury_2026-11-14_0130PM.json and injury_2026-11-15_0615AM.json. One consecutive diff: data/official/injury_diff_2026-11-14_0130PM_to_2026-11-15_0615AM.json. The fetcher downloads PDFs.
rows.gap: No injury PDF file is tracked in git (0 .pdf files in the repository). Raw PDFs are not retained. Only one consecutive pair is diffed. See flag F82.

rows.requirement: Freeze a pre-registration file per strategy before its first bet: signal, thresholds, universe, exact settlement rule.
rows.evidence: data/prereg/ holds S01–S08, T-SINGLE, T-PARLAY, T-SGP and an index. Each file has signal, thresholds, universe, exact_settlement_rule, frozen_at_utc, first_tip_of_universe and frozen_before_first_tip = true.
rows.gap: All files were frozen 2026-11-15T12:55Z, after the 11/14 picks were published (ledger entry 1, 2026-11-14T22:18:48Z). The 11/14 results are therefore not pre-registered evidence. See flag F78.

rows.requirement: Tamper-evident ledger: hash each published pick, publish the hash before tip, verify after settlement.
rows.evidence: data/ledger/ledger.json is a SHA-256 hash chain: entry 1 pre-tip publication, entry 2 settlement verification, entry 3 settlement record. scripts/verify_ledger.py reports 'ledger chain OK'.
rows.gap: The anchor commit ef2e723 is not an ancestor of origin/main, which is a single squashed root (cd8fd27). It is reachable only through branch history. See flag F79.

rows.requirement: Split the site into a 'projection' surface (safe to publish now) and a 'bet' surface (gated), and never mix them.
rows.evidence: Gated paper picks are labelled as gated on the picks page, and prop-variance and props pages carry their own labels. The picks page does not split into two separate surfaces.
rows.gap: No separate projection and bet surfaces exist. A reviewer decision is needed on the split (see Decisions page).

rows.requirement: Keep two independent estimators and publish their disagreement as the primary confidence signal, not a single blended rating.
rows.evidence: The picks table shows 'Ref home margin' beside 'Model home margin' and 'Spread edge'. No second independent estimator module was found by search, and no disagreement headline was found.
rows.gap: Build a second, independent estimator and publish the disagreement as the headline. See flag F87.

rows.requirement: Pin home-court advantage to the measured home-win rate instead of fitting it freely.
rows.evidence: engine/model_core.py uses a fixed flat_hca = 2.0. scripts/originate_horizon.py records that HCA 'could not be sourced from an official NBA page'. The 57.6% measured home-win rate from another build is a note only, not applied.
rows.gap: Measure the home-win rate from official finals and apply it. See flag F84.

rows.requirement: Report luck as a z-score per team; refuse to publish a strategy that leans on a team outside the noise band.
rows.evidence: command-center/data/luck.json computes luck_z for all 30 teams from Pythagorean expectation (exponent 13.91) on official OffRtg and DefRtg. The Luck page is built from it.
rows.gap: No noise-band refusal rule was found in code or pages, so strategies are not gated on it. See flag F88.

rows.requirement: Compute rest, back-to-back and 3-in-4 from the official schedule, and add travel distance from a sourced arena-coordinate table.
rows.evidence: Rest and back-to-back are shown per game on the Game Flow page, computed from the official schedule. The 3-in-4 metric was not found by search.
rows.gap: No arena-coordinate table exists, so travel distance is not computed. 3-in-4 is not computed. See flag F85.

rows.requirement: Model minutes redistribution explicitly: for each team, the top-8 minutes shares and the replacement shares when a player is out.
rows.evidence: data/derived/injury_impact.json has a rotation block per team (regulation minutes available, minutes vacated, redistribution rule). Its own rule is labelled 'MODEL RULE, not measured'.
rows.gap: Top-8 minutes shares are not reported. The redistribution rule is unmeasured. See flag F89.

rows.requirement: Stop publishing a single blended rating as the headline; publish the disagreement as the headline and the blend underneath.
rows.evidence: Not found. The site headline was not verified to be a disagreement measure.
rows.gap: Depends on R08. Needs a reviewer decision on the headline.

rows.requirement: Price every parlay with the measured rho and print the naive product beside it instead of withholding the price.
rows.evidence: scripts/generate_picks.py prices SGPs with rho constants SGP_RHO_TEAMMATES = -0.2 and SGP_RHO_OPPONENTS = 0.05, labelled as model-derived. The correlations page holds rho values.
rows.gap: The rho is a fixed model constant, not a measured value. The naive-product column was not verified on the parlay table. See flag F90.

rows.requirement: Put rotation availability on the picks page as its own column.
rows.evidence: The picks table headers are Home injury status and Away injury status. No rotation-availability column exists.
rows.gap: Add the column from the injury impact data. See flag F83.

rows.requirement: Add a market-anchored prior: blend the model line with the closing line, weighted by measured out-of-sample log-loss.
rows.evidence: No closing line or licensed price exists in the repository. The prereg files state: 'No licensed two-sided price exists (no odds feed)'.
rows.gap: Needs a licensed or official price source before it can be built. See flag F86.

rows.requirement: Model the total as possessions times points per possession, not as an average of team scoring averages.
rows.evidence: scripts/originate_horizon.py: possessions = pace_home + pace_away − league_pace; points = (off_rtg × opp def_rtg ÷ league_off) × possessions ÷ 100; total = home points + away points. Inputs are the official team advanced stats.
rows.gap: None in the formula. Inputs are refreshed by R01.

rows.requirement: Show the injury-report revision time and retrieval time in the Injuries page banner.
rows.evidence: site/pages/injuries.html banner shows 'revision and retrieval time' with the revision and retrieved (UTC) fields.
rows.gap: None found for the banner. Source values are the official index edition.

rows.requirement: Settle the sealed ledger from official finals as soon as each game day ends, and keep the settlement stamp visible.
rows.evidence: The 11/14 settlement is recorded in the ledger (entry 3), and the Injuries page carries a 'settled and stamped' note.
rows.gap: Settlement is manual per slate, not scheduled. 11/15 has not yet been settled.

rows.requirement: Re-read the three official team-stat pages (traditional, opponent, advanced) and re-cut the model inputs.
rows.evidence: data/official/teams_traditional_2026-11-15.json, teams_opponent_2026-11-15.json and teams_advanced_2026-11-15.json each hold 30 rows with source_url and retrieved_utc. Model input files were re-cut from them (as stated in PR #106; the files are present in this tree).
rows.gap: Re-read 11/15 only. The next re-read depends on R01.

rows.requirement: Capture per-player game logs (minutes, points, rebounds, assists, opponent) for at least the players on an injury report.
rows.evidence: data/live/player_game_logs.json has 3 players, including Nikola Jokić, with minutes, points, rebounds, assists and opponent.
rows.gap: The 11/15 injury edition has 101 rows, so coverage is far short of the requirement. See flag F81.

rows.requirement: Originate our own NBA lines and research strategies, run them as a leaderboard competition with rewards, and validate each through gates.
rows.evidence: Strategies, validation gates and leaderboard pages built from data/derived/strategies.json and backtest.json. Reward tiers are defined. No strategy is promoted unless it clears the gates.
rows.gap: No licensed price exists, so unit ROI is blank for moneyline strategies (see R16).

rows.requirement: Look at single bets, parlays and player-prop combinations.
rows.evidence: Single-game picks, parlay tickets, SGPs and prop combinations are built and published (picks, props, prop-variance pages).
rows.gap: Prop combinations are priced without a market price (see R16).

rows.requirement: Determine correlation values and select strategies that are skill-based rather than luck.
rows.evidence: data/derived/correlations.json and site/pages/correlations.html publish the measured correlation values. The luck check is on the Luck page.
rows.gap: Skill-versus-luck selection is limited by the sample size. The noise-band refusal is missing (R10).

rows.requirement: Generate picks for every upcoming slate up to 3 days in advance using our originated lines.
rows.evidence: data/derived/horizon_lines.json and horizon_picks.json cover the 11/15–11/18 window: 34 games, matching data/official/schedule_2026-11-15_to_18.json.
rows.gap: The window rolls forward with each refresh (R01).

rows.requirement: Track how injuries could affect rotation minutes and production, and provide game-flow analysis.
rows.evidence: data/derived/injury_impact.json (player and team effects) and site/pages/gameflow.html (pace, margin, total, blow-out and overtime probability).
rows.gap: The rotation model is unmeasured (R12). Production effects rest on few observed games (R21).

rows.requirement: Create an executive summary outlining the important details.
rows.evidence: EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md at the repository root and the Executive Summary page built from data/content/executive.json.
rows.gap: Refresh when data changes.

rows.requirement: Suggestions section so someone can review options and pick a path before any change is made.
rows.evidence: site/pages/suggestions.html and site/pages/decisions.html, built from data/content/suggestions.json (31 items).
rows.gap: Decisions are not yet recorded by a reviewer.

rows.requirement: Clear list of questions, information and answers needed before any decision.
rows.evidence: site/pages/questions.html built from data/content/questions.json.
rows.gap: Answers are open and carry their own status.

rows.requirement: Line-by-line repository review with flagged irregularities and links for manual review.
rows.evidence: REPO_REVIEW.md, the Repo Review page and the Flagged for Review register (data/content/flagged.json).
rows.gap: Not every line was reviewed in this session. This session added flags F78–F91.

rows.requirement: GitHub Pages live site with a clean landing page and subpages organised by category, each table row linked to an official source.
rows.evidence: pages.yml builds and deploys site/ on push to main. scripts/check_site.py checks that every table row on its listed pages carries an official link.
rows.gap: Row links are checked for the approved host only. Sandbox limits mean nba.com URLs are not re-fetched here (F91).

rows.requirement: Verify every value against an official source; leave blank and flag anything unconfirmed.
rows.evidence: Probe record: 1,911 URLs probed from the runner, 114 OK, 1,679 blocked, 116 unreachable. The site flags unconfirmed values.
rows.gap: Most nba.com URLs were blocked from the probe runner and cannot be re-read from this sandbox. See flag F91.

rows.requirement: Parallel sessions coordinate through a shared task board with claims, file scopes and handoffs.
rows.evidence: COORDINATION.md holds the registry, ground rules, claims and delivery records.
rows.gap: Board is long and has many sessions' records.
